newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Moody's confirms Pohjola A3 financial strength.
newsitem.headline: Moody's confirms Pohjola A3 financial strength.

text.p: U.S. credit rating agency Moody's said on Friday it was confirming the A3 financial strength rating of Finland's Pohjola Insurance Co Ltd.

"The rating action reflects Moody's belief that...the financial condition of the non-life operations remains strong and the company's business fundamentals remain essentially unchanged," the agency said.
This was despite the substantial change in the capitalisation of Pohjola's non-life operations as a result of the planned restructuring.
Pohjola has historically served a dual role in the group, acting both as the ultimate parent company and as a property and casualty insurer.

The restructuring involves renaming Pohjola, in its holding company capacity, as the Pohjola Group Ltd, creating a new insurance company, Pohjola Non-Life, and then transferring the non-life book to this new insurer.

"Since the insurance and financial strength rating applies to the property and casualty operations, the transfer of this businesss to a new company will entail the withdrawal of the rating from the former Pohjola and its reassignment to Pohjola Non-Life," Moody's said.

"Moody's believes that the amount of reserves and solvency capital that will be allocated to the Pohjola Non-Life operations, the rated entity, is adequate in relation to the type and volume of business written, and allows some flexibility for organic growth," the agency said.
